acceptance_matrix.observable_result: The append-only ledger preserves all 646,053 POST-SUBTASK-040 decisions and materializes 313,712 interval-backed team, conference, staff, roster, coach, and player-transfer transition events. Every event is attributable and decision-known-at; every temporal event carries an effective interval. Zero manual acceptances and zero correction, merge, or split events were created because no independent evidence package supported them. The strict validator rejected retroactive alias rewriting without an explicit correction and superseded-event identity.

The declared output is a 3,724-byte four-record JSONL control log that pins the 190,729,009-byte external Parquet payload, 959,765 rows, 50 columns, schema identity, prerequisite identities, append-only correction rules, negative findings, and POST-SUBTASK-042 fail-closed consumer requirements. Two independent deterministic builds produced the same payload and byte-identical build reports.

The work preserves 5,817 candidate-generated, 1,941 review-required, and 1,404 unresolved ledger events without promotion. Historical source-known-at timestamps are absent in the prerequisites, so all temporal events remain fail-closed for historical PIT use. No source availability, calibrated confidence, model readiness, protected performance, A&M lift, BAS, Aggie Excess, or operational readiness is claimed.
